notes.title: Space Boat Accessibility Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Space travelers!

The latest Space Boat demo update is now live on Steam! We added several Accessibility features as well as quality of life improvements to this build. Since there seems to be a lot of interest in the details of what was done, I have put together a detailed list:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/7b57739370e18fd99453726d208145070cfeb879.png

Quality of life changes:

 The controller navigation in the character creator UI is much improved. The controller highlight box now moves around how many people would expect it to.
 We added a new UI element that distinguishes pre-built suits (like the Pepper-oh-noes suit) from custom designed suits.
 We added a covert level indicator in the character creator that describes more clearly why the mission cannot start. This will also open gameplay possibilities as well as open the door for items that can improve your covert rating.
 The FBC race map now has improved collision and a new wider passthrough gate. It has been used to improve the flow of the track.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/5ac589949e6d3d208f5b296a1442397757b70d1a.png

Accessibility Features:

 The pause menu is now available throughout the game (except during the chapter select screen which now has a similar menu with all the same features built-in). This change alone opened a number of bugs that have been addressed. I’ll spare you the details, but I think we can all agree that being able to change any settings or jump to any chapter at any moment is a win for everyone. 
 We finally added a Sound FX volume slider to our settings tab so that all sounds can now be adjusted by the player.
 We decided to keep the ambient music and game music on the same slider for streamers to easily mute out any song that is not our theme song and could lead to DMA strikes since some of our music might not be valid for streaming due to Premium Beat’s ever changing licensing agreements. Over the next year, we will be replacing all our licensed music to improve this situation.
 There’s been a lot of work done in the game for people with color blindness in the last year. For example, we added button prompts to what were originally just text color indicators. None the less, we have included the infamous color-blind shader option for the small minority of color-blind people that find it helpful. Please note that a lot of work is built into the art direction of the game, so this option is probably not necessary. The game was built to be color-blind friendly without it. 
 Mouse and controller sensitivity is now available. This is a win for everyone since not having it was an annoyance for many streamers as well.
 We added a framerate cap option for people who might need some processing power to go to another application other than the game (like OBS for example).
 We added an Auto-Run option to avoid having to hold the run button. Although running in Space Boat is not necessary, as a triple amputee myself, having to hold any button simultaneously in most games while operating other buttons is a quick way to get me to stop playing (although I have completed every Souls-Borne game there is). None the less, it is now an option which will at the very least, help players get through the electrified portion of the second chapter unscathed.
 We added an option for Single-Stick controls! Now you can walk and race without the need for two controller sticks. 
 Inverted controls was something that came up several times in the comments section. You can now switch it on here instead of having to go through any platform specific option.
 Finally, we added the option to toggle our subtitles. Previously they were always on, but now you can turn them off. These subtitles were designed for people with hearing impairments since they included descriptions of sounds.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/988f7f023340b882631921c6553b6d8c7767d800.gif

Recombobulator Games signing off!

notes.title: An important update on Space Boat
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/9be76413ba5bb4db52bdbaf2b1bffa0680a8b1e3.png

I went into Ray Gretz this morning and found Earl this way. I have no idea why the gift is not in the usual "storage" space. I took a picture and decided to investigate at a later date.


So, we're are at the end of our campaign and the results are looking like what we talked about during the last update, i.e.: nowhere near our initial goal. In a way I'm relieved we didn't just hit the goal, because there are a number of stretch goals that would make the game a whole lot better. Let's be real though, not making the initial goal is not great. However, like I mentioned last time we're not in a bad place. We have a great community, something secret coming up in December, and a chance to run a better campaign at a later date. Please stay tuned for a post-campaign update that will have all the details.


Just because the campaign ended, doesn't mean the fun stops. If you haven't already, follow our Twitter page for more animated gifs and pics or join our discord for some rather disturbing theories about Earl and Glenn.


Wishlist Space Boat and join our Discord because this is just the beginning of this Space Boat adventure.

notes.title: New Demo Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/9b1226afbd4476db0b579586f9b0964c12f45138.gif

Patch notes 

* Added music and voice volume control for Streamers to adjust volumes in-game.
* Added a much-anticipated interaction and cinematic involving Dale in the hangar. 
* Added a tutorial cone right before the electrical obstacle course to help players out.
* Added interactions for Space Chuck's sugar station and waste bins.
* Added small interaction for Cuckoo Cola machines.
* Added event that makes Dale turn his back and stop talking to you after you get the boarding pass.
* Added Vista voice lines to the outdoor Jelly Shore area.
* Fixed exploit with a collision in starting zone. No more fun for 99HealingPotions and Radders will be able to complete the Demo now.
* Fixed player movement while in opening cinematic. Thanks again 99HealingPotions.
* Fixed sliding doors at Ray Gretz and Space Chuck's from looking like a poltergeist possessed them when the framerate is low.
* Fixed icon display when using mouse and keyboard.
* Fixed mouse mode camera control when starting upper vents.
* Fixed SteamVR from being activated.
* Fixed an issue with tutorial cones previewing 2 objects at once.
* Fixed feature with the jelly dog that was perceived as a bug when spamming interact.
* Fixed NPCs on the boardwalk from getting stuck and leaving conversations while still active.
* Fixed cat-form collision to avoid getting stuck in things or putting head through pipes.
* Fixed collision exploit in Space Chuck's vents. No more skipping the area, Mr. 99HealingPotions.
* Removed tail collision since it would get caught in the electrical obstacle course and people would complain.


Don't forget to check out our Kickstarter & Come chat with us On Discord!
